title: Joseph McMoneagle's remote viewing of Soviet bases and the search for General Dozier

tellings.quote: Joseph mcmonagle mcmonagle used remote viewing to identify Soviet nuclear bases predict key critical events and he even helped locate kidnapped American General James doer

plain: A man named Joe McMoneagle used "remote viewing", the claimed ability to see far-off places with the mind alone, to find Soviet nuclear bases and foresee key events, according to Jesse Michels. Michels adds that McMoneagle even helped find James Dozier, an American general kidnapped in Italy. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as a sign that this kind of mind-sight worked well enough for real intelligence jobs.
